Brief deviations corrected at author time: (1) the lane carries 13 distinct meanings, not 12; (2) the brief's record-3 $999.00 figure is inconsistent with its own rounded inputs (414.5 x 2.41 = 998.945), so the bundle uses the exact conversion (109,500 gal = 414.502590348 m3; implied $2.4125301585/m3; forward $1,000.00); (3) the EPA 300-gal/day family figure was verified on the live How-We-Use-Water page (the Statistics page no longer carries it); (4) record-1 runtime-ready status was not taken because it needs a vocabulary change the curator may not ship. models.inverse_notes: Q = V / t requires t > 0 with Q >= 0 re-checked; t = V / Q requires Q > 0 with t >= 0 re-checked. Substitution: V = 180, t = 3600 gives Q = 0.05, and forward 0.05 x 3600 = 180.
